name: Temptation Cancun Resort
tagline: Best budget option — non-stop Vegas-style party energy

contact.address: Cancun Hotel Zone, Quintana Roo, Mexico

description: The most accessible entry point into the Riviera Maya lifestyle scene — a 430-room adults-only resort with an electrifying party atmosphere, Vegas-style Bash nightclub, topless-optional pool, and the largest social scene in the region. Ideal for first-timers and social couples on a budget.
highlights: Bash nightclub — outdoor Vegas-style club with LED stage, nightly shows
Topless-optional pool with high-energy daily parties
7 restaurants, 6 bars, late-night snack bar, gourmet café
Bash Tower rooms — balcony views of the party scene below
Central Cancun location — easy airport access, excursions nearby
considerations: Service can be inconsistent across large 430-room property
Food quality below premium resorts — decent but not exceptional
Noise levels high (especially Bash Tower rooms) — poor for light sleepers
Average guest age mid-40s — less mixed-age than some expect
Some guests report unexpected charges — confirm pricing upfront

reviews.name: Sergio D
reviews.text: Deeply disappointing experience due to a serious billing issue. A $22,500 MXN ($1,300 USD) security deposit from our November 2025 stay has still not been refunded after several months. The hotel claims it was only a 'hold,' but it clearly appears as a charge on our credit card statement. Customer service has provided zero resolution. Be very cautious with security deposits at check-in — make absolutely sure it processes as a hold and not a charge.

reviews.name: ron w
reviews.text: This place used to be our go-to twice a year since 2015 but it just took a nosedive. A new CEO has completely ruined this resort. We were slowly watching it go downhill and now it has completely lost what made it special. Time to find a new piece of paradise. Would advise others to do the same.

response.text: Thank you for sharing your feedback and for your loyalty since 2015. We are sincerely sorry your recent experience did not meet expectations. We would greatly appreciate specific details to help us address your concerns and improve.

reviews.name: Katie M
reviews.text: Be careful about upselling at this resort. At Sea Flirt the sommelier didn't discuss which bottles were included in our package and we ended up with a 5,000 peso ($280) wine bill we thought was covered. When I tried to resolve it, I was given the same sommelier to talk to instead of a manager — he just repeated 'you have to pay.' I felt completely unheard and it made me cry. Ask about every single item before accepting anything at any meal.

response.text: We are truly sorry about the confusion with the sparkling wine inclusion and the lack of clear communication. Your case has been escalated to our management team. We deeply regret that you felt unheard — this is not the level of service we strive to provide.

reviews.name: gene l
reviews.text: Very inconsistent experience. Food and drinks were hit or miss. Service was great overall and I had no stomach issues — which is often a problem in Mexico. Room was okay and comfortable but the AC just couldn't keep up and I had to ask for a fan. The gym was run down with no air conditioning. Not bad, but not great.

reviews.name: Marshall Bud P
reviews.text: Went solo for the first time to Temptation and loved the European vibe — lively and vibrant. Rooms are clean and neat. Staff is very accommodating. Drinks are top-shelf and food is varied and eclectic. Entertainment starts at 11am at the sexy pool and ends around 3am at Bash. The only downside was an excursion to see the Cenotes — get ready for the bumpiest ride of your life on that road.

response.text: Thank you for choosing Temptation for your first solo trip! We're thrilled you enjoyed the atmosphere, staff, food, and entertainment. We appreciate your feedback about the cenote tour road and have shared it with our tour partners.

reviews.name: Marene S
reviews.text: Had a great trip and I can't wait to go back. The entertainment was well done. Playmaker Edgar (Mojito) was friendly and fun. Sam, Brai, Andy, Will, Waldry, Cowboy, Red Bull, and Jolie were all amazing as well. The environment is welcoming and all the people were fun. The waiters were great too. Already looking forward to returning.

response.text: Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful feedback! We are thrilled to know you had a great trip and that Edgar and the playmaker team made your experience even more fun and memorable.

reviews.name: Abraham A
reviews.text: Another great trip despite concerns we'd heard about the ownership change. This place still has a great party vibe — sexy, not vulgar. Service is great and food is good. The Playmakers are the lifeblood of this resort: Dani Boy, Wild, Rafa, Cowboy, Red Bull, Mojito, Sam, Bride, MAG, Andrea La Diabla, Deli, and Day. You need to bring good energy and have fun — lots of it!

response.text: Thank you for sharing this fantastic feedback! We're thrilled the resort still delivers that unique, vibrant essence. Your kind recognition of our Playmakers team means the world to them. Looking forward to welcoming you back!

reviews.name: Stay17992008926
reviews.text: The experience was great. Leo was awesome as our butler. Aldo, Gerry, George, Albert, Mike, Ivan, and Diego made the whole trip — seeing all of them is what makes Temptation the best resort. They treat you like absolute family.

response.text: Thank you so much for your amazing review! We are truly delighted to know you had such a great experience. Leo, Aldo, Gerry, George, Albert, Mike, Ivan, and Diego will be thrilled to know they made such a positive impact on your stay.

reviews.name: JOSH S
reviews.text: The vibe of the resort is still the same. Everybody is so friendly and staff do a great job. Wendy down at the sexy pool is on it all the time — she goes over and above to make sure we are staying hydrated and happy. She remembers what we are drinking and will flag us down in the pool knowing we are close to needing a refill. She is amazing. The rooms do need a little TLC on door latches and hinges. The only thing we were disappointed in was that the nighttime pool party was cancelled without any notice. The website and advertisement TV in the elevator both said it was still going to happen.

response.text: Dear Guest, thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly happy to know that you continue enjoying the unique vibe of the resort and the friendliness of our staff. We will definitely recognize Wendy for her outstanding service at the Sexy Pool! We also sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding the nighttime pool party schedule. Your feedback is extremely valuable and we will review this matter internally to improve communication and avoid similar situations in the future.

reviews.name: kerilynn s
reviews.text: This was mine and my best friend's third time at Temptation. The staff is super wonderful. The playmakers (activities) staff is very fun and interactive. Dani Boy, Redbull and Bombon were so great and said hello every time I saw them. They even taught me the opening dance and I got to perform with them! We are already planning our trip back!

response.text: Thank you so much for coming back to Temptation for the third time! We are thrilled to know that our staff and Playmakers made your stay even more memorable. Dani Boy, Redbull, and Bombon will be so happy to hear your kind words! We love that you got to learn the opening dance and perform with the team. We cannot wait to welcome you and your best friend back soon!

reviews.name: Stay43031850222
reviews.text: I love coming to an adult-only resort. We are able to relax and have a great time at our level of comfort. The staff are amazing — they make sure that you are happy and engaged with no pressure to participate. The food is amazing. I love Sutra and Sea Flirt. Romanza is also a favourite with great options for all palates. We checked in with Premier (Thank you Norma!) and that was quick and painless. Going to miss the playmakers — shout out to Sam, Mojito, Bom Bon, Cowboy, Janice, Caesar, and Love Jones who made it so memorable with our group dinners. Mario was our butler — he went above and beyond to make sure we were well cared for. Thank you all for an amazing time.

response.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and wonderful review! We are truly delighted to know you continue choosing our resort as your favourite adults-only getaway. Your kind words about our staff will be shared with Norma, Mario, Caesar, Love Jones, Sam, Mojito, Bom Bon, Cowboy, and Janice. We cannot wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Katherine F
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting Temptation. It is a great party resort — topless optional — and we wanted a fun, upbeat resort with good energy, something different from the quieter luxury resorts we have stayed at before. Temptation definitely delivered on the fun vibe. We upgraded to the Tower with the Playful Experience and it was worth it for the perks, especially the massage which was incredible. Food surprised me in the best way — very good. Favourites: Sea Flirt, Sutra (the Temptation Roll was fabulous), dinner on the beach. The vibe is what makes this resort stand out — everyone is happy, friendly, and dancing from morning to Bash at night. Definitely dress up for the theme nights. If you are on the fence about trying something fun and different — just go.

response.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful and detailed review of your first experience at Temptation! We are truly delighted to know that the fun, energetic atmosphere exceeded your expectations. We love hearing that you enjoyed the Tower experience, our culinary offerings, and the vibrant theme nights. We cannot wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Farides R
reviews.text: Mike and I stayed at Temptation Cancun Resort for our anniversary, and it ended up being one of the most fun and relaxing trips we have had together. The hotel had an amazing adults-only atmosphere with great music, beautiful ocean views, delicious restaurants, and spotless facilities. We also loved the spa experience — staff were incredibly professional and attentive. One of the best parts of the trip was the entertainment team, especially Dany Boy. He always kept the energy high and made everyone feel welcome. Between the entertainment, bartenders, servers, and overall service, the entire experience felt unforgettable. We are already looking forward to coming back.

response.text: Thank you so much for celebrating your anniversary with us! We are truly delighted to know that you and Mike had such an incredible stay. Dany Boy will be thrilled to hear your kind words and to know that his energy helped make your vacation fun and unforgettable. We cannot wait to welcome you both back!

reviews.name: Paul D
reviews.text: My partner and I had an incredible time at Temptation Cancun Resort! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel welcome and taken care of. The restaurants were excellent with so many delicious options, the bartenders and waiters always kept the good vibes going, and our room was beautiful and spotless. We spent most of our days enjoying the pool parties and nightly shows, which were honestly the highlight of the trip. Special thanks to Dany Boy and Yoli for making every activity fun and unforgettable with their amazing energy and personalities. We left with great memories and cannot wait to visit again!

response.text: Thank you so much for your amazing review! We are absolutely thrilled to know that you and your partner had such an incredible stay with us. A very special thank you for recognizing Dany Boy and Yoli! We will be sure to share your kind words with them, as they will be delighted to know they helped make your vacation fun and unforgettable. We truly appreciate your preference and cannot wait to welcome you back!

reviews.name: Romeo C
reviews.text: Omar Lopez from security was always attentive to us — very cordial, kind, and took wonderful care of us. He always respected our privacy, and we felt safe the entire time. I would definitely return.

response.text: Estimado huesped, muchas gracias por compartir su experiencia y por reconocer el excelente servicio de Omar Lopez. Nos llena de alegria saber que siempre estuvo atento a ustedes, brindandoles una atencion cordial, amable y haciendolos sentir seguros y comodos en todo momento. La privacidad y seguridad de nuestros huespedes son muy importantes para nosotros. Sera un verdadero placer darles la bienvenida nuevamente muy pronto.
